_comment: The daily games, in display order. Used by the build (cards, hub, home band), the generators (scripts/games) and the tests. A game appears on the site once its page module content/pages/games/<key>.mjs exists. og is the share image in src/assets/og/. optional: the game's card is hidden on any day it has no puzzle, and games:check doesn't count it.
